text.tspan: Number of entries in biological sequence databases
Biological sequence databases store data such as DNA, RNA, and amino acid sequences and 3D protein
structures. This data includes entries from GenBank, RefSeq, PDB, UniProtKB/SwissProt, as well as predicted
protein structures in AlphaFoldDB and ESMAtlas.
